query: SELECT operation_id,item_id,record FROM password_write_intents intent WHERE team_id=$1 AND record->>'user_id'=$2 AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR operation_id>$3) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM password_item_entities item WHERE item.team_id=intent.team_id AND item.id=intent.item_id) ORDER BY operation_id LIMIT 100
